import re

from collections import Counter, defaultdict

from pathlib import Path

LINT_CONTENT_BUDGET = 120_000
WIKILINK = re.compile(r"\[\[([^\]|#]+)(?:[|#][^\]]*)?\]\]")

def page_name(rel: str) -> str:
    """Page name from a path or a wikilink target.

    Only `.md` is stripped, never `Path.stem`: a page called `Continue.dev`
    would lose `.dev` and stop matching its own file, which made every one of
    its 57 links read as dangling and the page itself as an orphan. The same
    hit `Cognitum.One`. Any page name containing a dot is affected.
    """
    name = Path(rel).name
    return name[:-3] if name.endswith(".md") else name


def scan(vault: Vault) -> dict:
    """Everything about the wiki that can be established by reading it."""
    pages = {}
    # index.md is part of the navigation surface and has the same link rules;
    # log.md is append-only history and is left alone.
    targets = sorted((vault.root / "wiki").rglob("*.md"))
    if (vault.root / "index.md").exists():
        targets.append(vault.root / "index.md")
    for path in targets:
        rel = path.relative_to(vault.root).as_posix()
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        pages[rel] = {
            "text": text,
            "name": page_name(rel),
            "links": [link.strip() for link in WIKILINK.findall(text)],
            "frontmatter": bool(re.match(r"^---\s*\n", text)),
            "type": (re.search(r"^type:\s*(\S+)", text, re.M) or [None, ""])[1]
                    if re.search(r"^type:\s*(\S+)", text, re.M) else "",
            "source_path": (re.search(r"^source_path:\s*(.+)$", text, re.M).group(1).strip()
                            if re.search(r"^source_path:\s*(.+)$", text, re.M) else ""),
        }

    by_name = defaultdict(list)
    for rel in pages:
        by_name[page_name(rel)].append(rel)

    wiki_names = {page_name(rel).lower() for rel in pages if rel.startswith("wiki/")}

    inbound = defaultdict(set)
    dangling = Counter()
    pathy = []
    for rel, page in pages.items():
        for link in page["links"]:
            # A path is always wrong. A trailing .md is only wrong when it names
            # a wiki page -- [[CLAUDE.md]] points at the schema file in the vault
            # root and resolves correctly, so rewriting it to [[CLAUDE]] would
            # break a working link rather than fix a broken one.
            if "/" in link or (link.endswith(".md")
                               and page_name(link).lower() in wiki_names):
                pathy.append((rel, link))
            target = page_name(link)
            if target in by_name:
                for hit in by_name[target]:
                    if hit != rel:
                        inbound[hit].add(rel)
            else:
                dangling[link] += 1

    # These are entry points; nothing links to them by design.
    entry_points = {"wiki/overview.md", "index.md"}
    orphans = [rel for rel in pages
               if rel not in entry_points and not inbound.get(rel)]

    # index.md is scanned for links but is not a wiki page: it has no
    # frontmatter by design, so counting it as a defect would make every
    # report noisy about something that is correct.
    wiki_pages = {rel: page for rel, page in pages.items() if rel.startswith("wiki/")}
    missing_frontmatter = [rel for rel, page in wiki_pages.items() if not page["frontmatter"]]

    broken_source_path = []
    for rel, page in pages.items():
        sp = page["source_path"]
        if sp and not (vault.root / sp).exists():
            broken_source_path.append((rel, sp))

    return {
        "pages": pages,
        "wiki_pages": wiki_pages,
        "inbound": inbound,
        "orphans": sorted(orphans),
        "dangling": dangling.most_common(),
        "pathy_links": pathy,
        "missing_frontmatter": sorted(missing_frontmatter),
        "broken_source_path": broken_source_path,
        "pending_sources": vault.pending(),
        "open_conflicts": find_conflicts(vault.root),
        "manual_edits": detect_manual_edits(vault.root),
    }


def fix_links(vault: Vault, report: dict) -> list:
    """Rewrite [[wiki/x/Foo]] and [[raw/y/Foo]] to the bare [[Foo]] the schema asks for.

    Mechanical, so no model is involved. Where a page with that name exists
    under a different case, the real page name is used -- [[Openhands]] would
    otherwise dangle beside the existing OpenHands page.
    """
    by_lower = {page_name(rel).lower(): page_name(rel) for rel in report["pages"]}
    offenders = {(rel, link) for rel, link in report["pathy_links"]}
    changed = []

    for rel in {rel for rel, _ in report["pathy_links"]}:
        text = report["pages"][rel]["text"]

        def replace(match, _rel=rel):
            inner = match.group(1).strip()
            alias = match.group(0)[2:-2][len(inner):]  # keep any |alias or #anchor
            # Only touch links the scan actually flagged, so a legitimate link
            # to a vault-root file is left alone.
            if (_rel, inner) not in offenders:
                return match.group(0)
            bare = page_name(inner)
            return f"[[{by_lower.get(bare.lower(), bare)}{alias}]]"

        fixed = re.sub(r"\[\[([^\]|#]+)((?:[|#][^\]]*)?)\]\]",
                       lambda m: replace(m), text)
        if fixed != text:
            vault.safe_write(rel, fixed)
            changed.append(rel)
    return changed
